notes.title: The Great Server Update!
notes.content:
Update Log 0.5.7

From the Goblin King:
I have rebuilt the server code. Pray I don't rebuild it further...

General

 Updated to the latest version of unity.
 Updated the networking dependencies to the latest version (always stressful).
 I have refactored the tagging code, it should be way better now. In general no more punching without actually tagging (though it may continue to punch after you tag)
 The camera should be hard locked to your goblin now. If at any time you have control of the goblin, and the camera is missing, it will spawn a new camera to lock it back on.


New Content

 New skin – Skeleton Outfit


Bugs

 Fixed a hidden bug that never came up before the server code rebuild because it always won a race condition. Upon upgrading the server, it started to lose the race condition and become apparent. This bug would cause a map to try to wait for players while switching levels instead of being in the inactive state. This caused mass chaos for the server.
 Condensed and refactored a lot of server and game mode code. This should solve a BUNCH of different issues.


Hide and seek
	Island
	
 Fixed the spawn location of runners so they don’t start on top of the taggers.
 	Platforms now have colliders.


Dodgeball
	
 Fixed the score not updating correctly in the GUI.
 	Dodgeball is now 50% bigger.
 	Dodgeball is now 50% faster.

	
Goblin Tag
	
 Fixed a bug where taggers wouldn’t get a random ability if they forgot to click one.

notes.title: Bug fixing
notes.content:
From the Goblin King:
I crush bugs.

General

 Removed number of players slider from hosting options.
 Maximum number of players per game has been lowered to 12.  I think this is an alright number for the moment, but I would like to raise this later when we have actual servers. Local host is particularly good for small games, but as the numbers get larger it can be hard on the hosts computer to deal with so many connections. Additionally, I need to optimize the game more for larger group games, as it’s having a lot of issues with anything too big.
 Passwords now available for your games. This is good for those that want a private gaming experience with just their friends.
 Spawning goblins will no longer look for a better place to spawn within the spawning zone. This may cause overlap with objects or other goblins sometimes – but will fix spawn lag.
 Updated the water colliders throughout the game. They should be a little tighter than before on the surface height but goes deeper now to make sure people die.
 Game now checks that players are on the same version when they try to join.


Hide and Seek	
Fixed a bug that would cause points to skyrocket – this was caused by having a runner respawn as a tagger within the timeframe that a game would end. They would then be both a runner and a tagger in the next round, this caused all sorts of craziness.
